title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount, Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage to a bathroom with this wall mount swing arm double towel rail. Two pivoting arms swivel independently for easy access, then fold in close to the wall to help save space.

Highlights:
- Swing arm towel rail / pivoting towel bar design for everyday convenience
- Double arms provide additional hanging space while keeping towels separated
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Solid brass construction
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place collection for cohesive transitional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish availability: multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Keyword context: waverly place collection, transitional bathroom hardware, versatile bath accessories, wall mount.
